description: This file defines an Angular service 'UserService' that provides methods for interacting with user-related API endpoints, including fetching, saving, deleting users, and managing activation links.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Angular service for user management API interactions.

methods.name: getUsers
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of users.

methods.name: getCustomerUsers
methods.description: Retrieves users associated with a specific customer.

methods.name: getUsersForAssign
methods.description: Gets users for assignment related to an alarm.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Fetches a specific user by ID.

methods.name: getUsersByIds
methods.description: Retrieves multiple users by their IDs.

methods.name: saveUser
methods.description: Creates or updates a user, optionally sending an activation email.

methods.name: getActivationLink
methods.description: Retrieves activation link for a user.

methods.name: getActivationLinkInfo
methods.description: Gets information about a user's activation link.

methods.name: sendActivationEmail
methods.description: Sends an activation email to a specified address.

methods.name: findUsersByQuery
methods.description: Searches for users based on a query.
